skills.name: audit-xls
skills.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
skills.description_zh: 审计选定区域、单个工作表或完整模型的公式、错误和常见问题，包括财务模型资产负债平衡、现金勾稽和逻辑合理性检查。

skills.name: nav-tieout
skills.description: Tie an LP statement to the fund's NAV pack — recompute the LP's capital account from the NAV components and flag any line that doesn't agree. Use before LP statements are distributed.

skills.name: xlsx-author
skills.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
skills.description_zh: 在没有打开 Office 应用的托管智能体环境中直接生成磁盘上的 .xlsx 文件，以无界面方式完成表格文件制作。
